name: Arisia
blurb: A fan-run Boston-area science fiction and fantasy convention with guests of honor, an art show and masquerade, currently on a one-year hiatus.
notes: Homepage banner: 'Arisia is taking a hiatus for 2027. We'll be back in 2028.' (next window, 2028, falls outside this research window of 2026-10-05 to 2027-12-31), so marked inactive/on hiatus with editions empty. The site itself still headlines the already-finished Arisia 2026 ('January 16 - 19, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency Boston/Cambridge'), recorded as 'last'.
